coarse_contract.canonical_tail_rule: aggregate the three role tails; floor(307*tail_values/1024) coarse bytes; never allocate a full N18 reservoir to a tail

handoff_contract.branch_rule: A DH384 best-of-64 pilot may kill only that frozen DH384 branch; it cannot kill coarse-programmed graphs, adaptive lifting, posterior reconstruction, syndrome refinement, joint coarse/fine search, or broader TACTIC-CAGE mechanisms.

shape_contract.dimensions: arbitrary positive intermediate and hidden dimensions within declared integer/product caps
shape_contract.explicit_frame_rule: use one contiguous owner frame iff floor(5*expert_weights/16) >= 8191 bytes
shape_contract.small_owner_fallback: otherwise decode the entire expert as an implicit all-zero expert with zero stored bytes and zero routed reads
shape_contract.tail_total_rule: the aggregate tail receives floor(5*tail_values/16) total bytes, split into the canonical coarse prefix and a tail refinement remainder
shape_contract.quality_boundary: the implicit fallback is a legal universal rate/read closure only; no distortion or usefulness claim is made for small experts

physical_contract.rate: for every positive declared shape, physical bytes <= floor(5*expert_weights/16), hence physical bpw <= 2.5
physical_contract.owner_layout: explicit expert frames are contiguous and unpadded; implicit owners have no interval
physical_contract.read_metric: the union of distinct 4096-byte pages intersecting one routed owner's frame divided by that owner's stored frame bytes
physical_contract.read_cap: every explicit owner has unique-page read amplification strictly below 2; every implicit owner has zero reads and amplification zero

source_execution_contract.bootstrap: an independent dispatcher must open, pin and hold immutable_bootstrap.py, then execute /proc/self/fd/N with the inherited FD and pinned bootstrap digest
source_execution_contract.inventory: an independently supplied flat exact-closure inventory is held by absolute no-follow FD and pinned by digest; row, name, member and aggregate caps apply before materialization
source_execution_contract.imports: all sibling Python modules execute from authenticated immutable byte packets through a dedicated loader; live-tree and pycache fallback are forbidden
source_execution_contract.dependencies: external prototype sources are absolute/no-follow held, byte-authenticated, AST-import-closed and exposed only as immutable packets; importing them additionally requires external runtime authority

runtime_contract.lock: a future external runtime lock must authenticate the held executable bytes and exact Python version plus every required distribution's version, RECORD bytes/digest and complete importlib.metadata tree digest
runtime_contract.fabrication_rule: negative, zero, empty, all-zero-digest and incomplete runtime fields are rejected

publication_contract.ordering: write and fsync ordinary files, write ARTIFACTS, write COMPLETE last in staging, fsync, enumerate and rehash the entire staging tree, chmod/final-fsync, then perform one renameat2 NOREPLACE publication
publication_contract.fault_rule: before rename no public tree may exist; after rename the only public tree was already complete and verified; constructor and abort paths remove private staging
publication_contract.phase_rule: publication phase is explicit and monotonically records the last attempted durability boundary

authority_contract.dispatcher_input: opaque held-FD assertion bound to source root, runtime root, action and independent audit evidence

telemetry_contract.requirements: strict CUDA/NVML UUID and PCI agreement, nonempty version identity, per-buffer transfer provenance and digests, synchronized event phases, wall time, memory baseline/peak/delta and explicit sampled-peak limitation
